name: Editorial image panels
description: Make a premium sound-off ad from a small asset set. Builds an editable 12-second vertical ad from your images, logo and copy. AI can suggest options from a website to fill the fields with its copy and images. No generated video.
tagline: A few strong stills and restrained type can communicate the value.

props.subtitle: A 5-scene vertical ad, 12 seconds long. You supply images and short lines of copy. The app builds an editable cut, not a generated video.

props.label: How do you want to start?

options.title: Fill from a website
options.description: Paste a product page. AI suggests the copy and images.

props.text: Reads the website, lays out every frame and finishes the cut. Pick one that reads images. Saved for next time.

props.label: Website
props.hint: The agent reads the page and suggests three filled versions, with real images from the site. Pick one, then check each step.

props.text: No site at hand? Try this one.

props.subtitle: One strong image and a headline open the ad. The image comes back with your promise.

props.text: Your strongest image. It opens and closes the ad.

props.subtitle: Each panel adds one image and one line to the grid.
The main image holds with a clear next step.

props.text: Optional. Paints backgrounds and decoration for the layout. Saved for next time.

props.text: Edit the cut or plan again. You can still approve it.

operations.name: Suggest options from a website
operations.agentTask: Read the website in `sourceUrl` and write three different ways to fill the ad "Editorial image panels". Objective: Make a premium sound-off ad from a small asset set. Visual rule: A deliberate grid and stable type do most of the work; motion reveals one panel at a time. Beats, in order: - 0–2 s: Headline sits beside or above a single strong image. Shows Brand color, Main image, Headline. - 2–4.5 s: Second image creates a two-panel composition. Shows Brand color, Main image, Panel 2, Panel 2 line. - 4.5–7 s: Third image completes the grid. Shows Brand color, Main image, Panel 2, Panel 3, Panel 3 line. - 7–9.5 s: Return to the strongest image with a short promise. Shows Brand color, Main image, Promise. - 9.5–12 s: Hero image plus clear next step. Shows Brand color, Main image, , Logo, Call to action. Use only facts the website or pages you read state. Never invent prices, discounts, dates, guarantees or claims. When a fact a field needs is missing, write a short placeholder in square brackets, such as [offer end date]. Make the three options clearly different in angle, wording and image choice. For images, choose real, large images of this brand and product: first from the page's own images (header logo, large files, feature-page screenshots), then with an image search. A social preview card (og:image, a title on a gradient) is a last resort. Give the direct URL of the image file, never a page URL, and never an image of another brand. Use an empty string when no image fits. If image search throws because no search backend is configured, tell the user in one sentence that a SerpAPI, DataForSEO or Brave key in Settings finds better images. Then take nodetool.web.screenshot of the product's feature pages instead. Save each image you consider as an asset and look at it with view_image before you offer it. Name in the option's description any image that is only a social preview card. Write `fillOptions` as a list of three objects, `fillChoice` as "" and `fillReport` as "". Each option: - value: "1", "2" or "3" - title: a name for the direction in 2 to 4 words - description: one sentence on what it emphasizes, then the first two copy lines in quotes - image: the URL of its first image, for the option card - brandColor: the brand's accent color as #RRGGBB (buttons, links, highlights), not the page background or a theme-color that is near black or white - fields: headline (Headline: hook, at most 7 words); benefit1 (Panel 2 line: panel 2, at most 7 words); benefit2 (Panel 3 line: panel 3, at most 7 words); promise (Promise: hero, at most 7 words); cta (Call to action: cta, at most 4 words) - images: panel1 (Main image: A real photo or screenshot that matches the beats that show it. Shown in: Headline sits beside or above a single strong image. | Second image creates a two-panel composition. | Third image completes the grid. | Return to the strongest image with a short promise. | Hero image plus clear next step.); panel2 (Panel 2: A real photo or screenshot that matches the beats that show it. Shown in: Second image creates a two-panel composition. | Third image completes the grid.); panel3 (Panel 3: A real photo or screenshot that matches the beats that show it. Shown in: Third image completes the grid.); logo (Logo: The brand's own logo file, such as the site header logo or its icon. Shown in: Hero image plus clear next step.) Then show the Start step with `only: ["fillChoice"]` and a one-sentence note, so the user sees just the option cards. Picking one runs `apply`, which saves the images and fills the steps.
